description.value: A mid-scale chain hotel and suites property in Williams Lake offering standard rooms, studio suites, and multi-bedroom kitchen suites across several floors. The property holds GreenStep Silver Certification for sustainability practices benchmarked against Global Sustainable Tourism Council standards, including linen-reuse, recycling, and an EcoFund contribution program. On-site amenities include an indoor pool, fitness centre, and a Denny's Restaurant with room service.

Free Wi-Fi is explicitly and repeatedly confirmed across all room listings and the amenities page; Denny's Restaurant is confirmed on-site with room service providing nearby evening food; and USB Charging Ports are listed as an in-room amenity in the Standard Room subpage, confirming device charging.
